Zenbu Kimi No Seida 2026

Performance hosted by Cosmic Asia at Lalaport BBCC, Kuala Lumpur 2026

Chinese New Year 2025 →

Had zero idea who they were but I decided to stay around and watch the performance. I lost my flash cable and my bigger flash was not with me. I had to settle with my Godox Lux Senior, which has smaller flash power, and used bulb mode on the camera then triggered the flash manually. I got very lucky when the singer interacted with the crowd, which made the crowd go rowdy. I managed to get close while she crowd surfed.
